title: Reduce Month-End Close Time: Cash-in-Transit & Reconciliation
summary: Gain insights into automating bank reconciliation in our webinar. Learn to reconcile processor fees and reduce your time to close from days to minutes with actionable tips.
body_markdown:
Watch our webinar to gain insight into the art of automating bank reconciliation. Discover the intricacies of reconciling processor fees and witness how Blue Onion seamlessly connects the dots. Plus, receive actionable tips on reducing your time to close from days to minutes!


### Presenter


1. Brian Webb | *VP of Customer Experience* | Blue Onion
